cards.text: A while back, Jesus sent His twelve apostles out two by two, and they went out preaching and healing the sick (Mark 6:7-13). Now they're back, gathered around Him, telling Him all they've done and taught. But so many people are coming and going that they don't even have time to eat, the kind of day where your cookie is still on your desk at quitting time with ONE bite out of it.

cards.question: With people everywhere and no time to eat, Jesus tells His apostles to come away with Him to a solitary place and ___ for a while.

cards.text: So they get in a boat and head off by themselves to a solitary place. FINALLY, some peace and quiet.

cards.question: Lots of people see Jesus and the apostles leaving in the boat and recognize them. What do those people do?

answers.text: Run there on foot and get there first
Wait on the shore for the boat to come back
Go back home to their own towns

cards.text: Jesus steps ashore at the quiet getaway, and there's a large crowd waiting. That's like sneaking out to your car for five quiet minutes and finding the whole office already in the back seat.

cards.question: Jesus came to this place to rest, but when He sees the crowd, He has compassion on them. True or false: He sends the crowd away.
Jesus sees the crowd is like sheep without a shepherd. What does He begin to do for them?

answers.text: Pray with them by the sea
Sing psalms with them on the shore

cards.text: By now it's late, and the disciples come to Jesus and say, "This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late."

cards.question: It's late and they're out in a desolate place. True or false: the disciples tell Jesus to send the crowd off to the villages to buy themselves something to eat.

cards.text: But Jesus tells them, "You give them something to eat." I bet the disciples feel like they just got volunteered to throw the whole company party. TONIGHT.
They ask Him, "Should we go out and spend two hundred denarii to give all of them bread to eat?" Jesus tells them to go and see how many loaves they have.

cards.question: The disciples go check how much food they have for this huge crowd. What do they find?

answers.text: Far too little to go around

cards.text: After checking, they come back with five loaves and two fish. Five loaves. Two fish. For ALL these people.

cards.question: Jesus has five loaves and two fish to work with. What does He have the disciples get the people to do?

answers.text: Sit down in groups on the green grass
Head off to the villages in groups

cards.text: So they sit down in groups of hundreds and fifties. Friend, that's a restaurant seating a packed house with ONE cookie in the kitchen.

cards.question: Jesus takes the five loaves and the two fish. True or false: before He breaks the loaves, He looks up to heaven and speaks a blessing.
Jesus breaks the loaves. True or false: He gives the pieces to His disciples to set before the people.
Jesus divides the two fish among them all, and they all eat and are ___.
Everyone has eaten their fill. Then the disciples pick up the broken pieces of bread and fish. How much do they gather?

cards.text: And the men who ate the loaves? Five thousand. My ovens run every single day, friend, and I have NEVER fed a crowd like that.
